image_description: A close-up photograph featuring two prominent white daisies with bright yellow centers against a dark, blurred background. A third partial daisy is visible in the upper left corner. The flowers exhibit classic composite structure with radiating white ray florets and textured yellow disc florets.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Composite flower with central yellow disc surrounded by single whorl of white ray petals.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Both main subjects clearly display the composite structure with distinct yellow centers and white surrounding petals.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Flower head is modest in size with numerous elongated white petals radiating outward.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The petals are elongated and radiate correctly from the center; count appears consistent with natural variation (approx 15-20 visible per flower).

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Bright yellow center with bumpy, granular texture from individual disc florets.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The yellow centers show detailed granular texture consistent with disc florets, not just a flat yellow circle.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Petals narrow, slightly pointed, arranged in flat, circular pattern.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Petals are narrow with rounded-to-slightly-pointed tips, arranged in a planar radial symmetry.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Slender green stem supporting flower head.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Green stems are visible beneath the flower heads, particularly under the right-hand flower.
The depth of field blurs the lower stem area significantly; no distinct leaves are resolvable in the frame.
The image is a close-up macro shot; the ground/soil line is completely outside the frame or obscured by darkness.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Single stem supporting composite flower head.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Each flower head appears supported by its own individual stem structure, consistent with daisy morphology.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Central disc florets form textured yellow center.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Redundant with Flower_or_Top checkpoint but confirmed: the texture is present and realistic.

artifact_observations.reasoning: Slight softness/blurring on the edges of the upper-left petals of the left flower compared to the sharper right flower, possibly due to depth-of-field simulation or minor generation inconsistency.
The partial third flower in the top left merges slightly indistinctly into the dark background, lacking clear edge definition, though this may be intentional bokeh.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific species classification and rule out look-alikes like chamomile or aster based on petal/disc ratio.
To assess overall sharpness, noise levels, and detect subtle generative artifacts in the petal textures.
To verify that individual petals are distinct entities and do not fuse with each other or the background, a common AI failure mode.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the boundary between the white petals and the dark background. AI models often create 'halos' or bleeding edges here. Also, verify if the granular texture of the yellow center is consistent across both flowers or if one looks artificially smooth/painted.
